title: Scientific Documentation Workflow
definition: A comprehensive and rigorous workflow for creating scientific-grade documentation, from initial text entry to professional PDF output.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a step-by-step process that turns your notes into professional-looking documents. It's like turning a draft into a finished book, but for reports and documents.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: A systematic approach that includes document type selection, source content creation, metadata application, quality checks, and scientific PDF generation. It also incorporates version control and final verification.
difficulty_levels.expert: A novel application of the CADMIES audit framework methodologies, this workflow ensures documentation meets NASA-level standards. It also promotes best practices and standards, such as metadata usage, version control, and quality assurance checklists. Furthermore, it provides a scientific workflow automation solution, which sets it apart from traditional documentation methods.

extra_fields.insight: The conversation highlighted the importance of a comprehensive and rigorous workflow for creating scientific-grade documentation.
